subject: [PATCH v6 12/12] NFSD: Remove DRC checksum and payload_misses stat

reviews.author: Chuck Lever
reviews.summary: Reviewer questioned the new NFSD behavior, noting it may cause issues for existing NFSv4.0 clients, and suggested rethinking whether this change will be problematic.
reviews.raw_body:
The new NFSD behavior is by design, suggested by Neil. Any client
that reuses an XID on the same connection is either broken or has
sent 4 billion requests in 120 seconds. Clients are supposed to
send retransmits on a different connection.

So, it's possible the test is wrong, but we need to think hard
about whether this new behavior will be a problem for existing
NFSv4.0 clients.


-- 
Chuck Lever (Come to NFS bake-a-thon! https://nfsv4bat.org)

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch removes the DRC checksum and payload_misses stat from NFSD, which was causing issues with pynfs RPLY14 test due to a broken replay mechanism.
